Thiago Wall was found to have unsurvivable hypoxic brain injury and died three days after incident, coroner says

A three-year-old boy who had a medical emergency at a nursery near Manchester died from choking on food, an inquest has heard.

Thiago Wall was taken to hospital from Cosy Toes nursery in Middleton on 2 November, a week after his third birthday.
